newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Henry Walker says order book grows.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Henry Walker says order book grows.

text.p: Mining engineer and construction group Henry Walker Group Ltd said on Wednesday that its work on hand as at October 31 was A$915 million compared with A$890 million a month earlier.

"The value of the work contracted to be performed in the 1997 financial year (inclusive of work conducted to date) is estimated to be approximately A$350 million. This compares to the total contracting revenue of A$314 million in the 1996 financial year," the company said.
Henry Walker said last month that work in hand at the end of the June 30 fiscal year was A$829 million.
